description: This file defines the CandidateJobOfferingAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It provides an API endpoint for offering a job to a candidate, including API documentation annotations and a method to get the resulting workflow state.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPI
classes.description: An API class providing functionality related to offering a job to a candidate within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the 'offer job' action for a recruitment application.
